items.title: Derek Brown interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, March 5, 2021
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] My name is Monk Rowe... [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah, thanks for having me, Monk.

ctx.x: My name is Monk Rowe for the Fillius Jazz Archive and I’m very pleased to have, on a Friday afternoon, Derek Brown with me. And we are not together but we’re going to be together for about an hour. Thanks for joining me.
Yeah, thanks for having me, Monk. I’m glad to be here.
Congratulations on your, was it last year you did a fifty state tour?
